Monster is a psychological horror about this renowned brain surgeon who performs life-saving surgery on a Mayor's son, instead of the mayor, and as a result he's shunned and loses reputation with the hospital and even loses his fiance. Afterwards, the doctors who replaced him and the hospital director are murdered. Seen as one of the primary suspects, he must investigate and find the truth, to clear his name. Its a suspenseful, tense game of cat-and-mouse. Its a longer series, having 74 episodes.
